entries.title: Live chat no longer dead-ends
changes: Stopped showing “the live model is still responding” when the cloud call actually failed
If the live model misses, you get a real answer or local product help instead of a stuck retry loop

entries.title: cs.AI web app
changes: New web app at chopstickshq.com/chopsticks-ai/web/ — full agent in the browser
Chromium browser rail, Fathom Pro key redemption, cloud sync with macOS
Short URL /csai/ redirects to the web app

entries.title: Browser fix + Google discoverability
changes: Fix Chromium browser opening about:blank in the system dialog (ads/iframes stay in-app)
Improved Google SEO: sitemap priority, SoftwareApplication schema, download-focused meta

entries.title: Chromium browser
changes: Browser rail replaces Mozilla search — full in-app Chromium browser (Google, back/forward, URL bar)
Chromium search engine for chat grounding (Google web + DuckDuckGo, Chrome UA)
Search toggle and /search still work; macOS app opens pages inside the app

entries.title: Terminal CLI + shift-click organize
changes: New csai terminal CLI — full-screen UI like Grok Build (type csai in Terminal)
Install: curl -fsSL https://chopstickshq.com/chopsticks-ai/install-csai-cli.sh | bash
Commands: csai ask, csai login, csai update, csai version
Shift-click chats in the sidebar to select a range
Command-click to add or remove individual chats from the selection
Drag, drop, or use Move to file on multiple selected chats at once

entries.title: Drag chats into files
changes: Drag and drop chats into chat files in the Agents sidebar
Drop onto a file header or empty file to move a chat in
Drop onto Unfiled to remove a chat from its file

entries.title: Chat files
changes: Create chat files in the Agents sidebar to organize conversations
Start new chats inside a file, move chats between files, or leave them Unfiled
Rename and delete chat files from the sidebar context menu
Chats and file layout persist locally per account

entries.title: Stop KB hijacking live chat
changes: Fixed general questions (e.g. Minecraft SMP servers) returning chopstickshq.com portfolio KB snippets while Online
Server no longer substitutes offline KB answers when the live model fails — online clients get a retry prompt instead
KB grounding only applies on strong product matches, not bare keywords like “minecraft”
Search toggle in the macOS app is respected again — Search on runs Mozilla lookup on each question
Widget and Lab send onlineMode so the API knows not to fall back to local KB

entries.title: Online means live
changes: Fixed Online badge showing while answers came from the offline KB — online mode never uses local KB now
macOS and site widget always call the live model when Online; KB only when Offline mode is on or there is no network
Live requests skip automatic web search by default (use /search … to force lookup) so replies finish reliably
Retries with a lighter tier before asking you to send again — no more silent KB fallback while connected

entries.title: Many bug fixes
changes: Fixed website widget AI — no more false “model unreachable” when chopstickshq.com was up
Widget skips automatic web search by default so replies finish before the server timeout
API fast path for the site widget — lighter search, no refine pass, faster replies
macOS app retries without search when the live model fails, then local KB instead of a dead-end error
Removed harsh “Check your connection to chopstickshq.com” — graceful fallback while the model catches up
Online mode hardened: live model whenever Wi‑Fi/network is connected; Offline mode is opt-in in Settings → Chat
Settings → Chat tab — connection status (Wi‑Fi / Cellular / Offline) and Online/Offline toggle
Updater fix: patch builds (2.3.6a → 2.3.6b) and v-prefix manifest versions compare correctly
Fixed false “update available” when already on the latest build
Web and Lab show server replies instead of “unreachable” when the API returns an answer
Flat usage billing per reply — higher effort tiers no longer burn allowance faster
Context window limits apply correctly per tier (contextFor bug fix)
Six-language replies: English, 中文, Español, Deutsch, 한국어, 日本語

entries.title: 2.3.6a
changes: Patch release — version bump and updater fix for 2.3.6 → 2.3.6a

entries.title: Hardened online mode
changes: Online mode is always on by default — live model whenever Wi‑Fi or network is connected
No automatic KB fallback while online; API errors show a retry message instead
New Settings → Chat tab with connection status and Offline mode toggle (opt-in local KB)
Lab and site widget match: Online/Offline toggle, no silent fallback when connected

entries.title: Fixes + six languages
changes: Fixed false “update available” when already on the latest build
Web and macOS show server replies instead of “model unreachable” when the API returns an answer
Flat usage billing per reply — higher effort tiers no longer burn allowance faster
Reply language: English, 中文, Español, Deutsch, 한국어, 日本語

entries.title: Email + password only
changes: Removed 6-digit verification email — create account with email and password only
Sign-in still runs on chopstickshq.com, not Supabase Auth in the client
Offline KB fallback only when the device has no network — not when the live model fails while online

entries.title: Email sign-in (no Supabase Auth in app)
changes: Email/password sign-in restored — auth runs on chopstickshq.com, not Supabase Auth in the client
New accounts: 6-digit verification code emailed from cs.AI
Signed-in chats sync across Lab and macOS; premium tiers require sign-in or Fathom Pro keys

entries.title: No Supabase Auth
changes: Removed email/password sign-in and Supabase Auth — no cloud account required
Chats stay local on this Mac and in Lab; attachments read locally only
Premium tiers (ChopCode, StickerCoder+, Insane, etc.) work with Fathom Pro keys only — no sign-in gate

entries.title: No Keychain prompt
changes: Sessions and unlock keys stored in app preferences — no macOS login keychain password dialog
Ad-hoc installs no longer trigger Keychain access on launch
Retrieval still uses keyword intent scoring and Mozilla search — not vector embeddings

entries.title: No vector embeddings
changes: Retrieval uses keyword intent scoring and Mozilla web search — not vector embeddings
Removed “couldn't reach its model” dead-end; KB fallback and extra rescue instead
Signup verification via Supabase Auth email (not Resend)
Privacy stance: no embedding index, no semantic vector store

entries.title: Security update
changes: All messages are encrypted end-to-end — chats protected in transit and at rest
HMAC-SHA256 unlock keys; vault password verified server-side only
Sessions and unlock keys stored in macOS Keychain
Per-account chat isolation — sign in or out resets local state cleanly
API rate limits, tier gating, and restricted CORS on the edge
Privacy mode skips cloud API and sync entirely

entries.title: Final
changes: Toggle web search off in Settings or from the composer Search chip
Dynamic usage meters — context and allowance progress bars update live
Web search off badge, placeholder, and header update when search is disabled
`/search …` still forces a one-off Mozilla lookup when search is off
Lab matches macOS: Search toggle and centered progress bars in the composer

entries.title: Rescue path actually fires after search
changes: After web search, rescue uses the fast nano model in short slices instead of one hung attempt
Model budget shrinks when search used part of the platform time limit

entries.title: Fix empty/hung free-model replies
changes: Handle reasoning models that return empty content by retrying with a larger token budget
Fail fast per attempt (8s cap) so rescue models can answer instead of hanging Offline
Prefer the faster nano model on High effort

entries.title: Slim rescue for search-heavy answers
changes: If the main model times out after web search, a slim rescue call answers without the search blob
Tighter search snippets so grounded questions stop starving the model

entries.title: Harder fix for model reachability
changes: Reserved rescue model attempt so busy free models can’t burn the whole request
write_file tools only when coding / file requests (not every chat turn)
StickerCoder+/ChopCode skip web search unless you use /search

entries.title: Fix model timeouts / sticky Offline
changes: Model deadline no longer includes web-search time — stops “couldn't reach its model” on normal questions
Coding tiers fall back to another model when the primary is busy; short rescue completion as last resort
macOS Offline badge only sticks when the host is actually offline (not on transient errors)

entries.title: StickerCoder+
changes: New StickerCoder+ effort — coding specialist mode in Lab and the macOS app
Pick StickerCoder+ alongside ChopCode for agentic coding and file creation

entries.title: Tool-call files · labeled sidebar · more settings
changes: Agent can create files via write_file tool-calls (Lab + macOS); replies include downloadable file cards
macOS nav rail shows text labels (toggle in Settings → General)
More settings: Tools (write_file, confirm save, default folder), Agents (file tools), Beta (file previews)

entries.title: Expandable sidebar · 500 MB uploads
changes: macOS Agents Window: animated expand/collapse for the secondary sidebar (rail toggle)
Attachment limit set to 500 MB per batch (Lab + macOS)

entries.title: File & image attachments
changes: Attach files and images in Lab and the macOS app when signed in
Uploads go to private Supabase Storage (resumable for large files); text previews reach the model, large binaries by link

entries.title: ChopCode mode
changes: New ChopCode effort — coding specialist mode in Lab and the macOS app
SEO keywords for cs.AI / ChopCode on HQ homepage and product page

entries.title: Mozilla Search in the macOS app
changes: New Search rail in the Agents Window — same Mozilla engine as the website (MDN, Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo)
Results open in your browser; no API key required

entries.title: Mozilla engine, profile plans, What’s New

Mozilla search engine on /chopsticks-ai/#search (MDN, Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo) — same path the AI uses first
Account plans read from Supabase profiles (token_budget / context_limit / plan_label) — no hard-coded emails
Usage soft warning at 80% allowance + live cooldown countdown
macOS app shows What’s New from changelog.json after an update

entries.title: Accounts, Usage, and Cursor-style Agents

Optional Supabase accounts — sign in to sync chats across Lab and the macOS app
Usage tab with Fathom Pro oi-pl credit upgrades (not OpenRouter keys)
Credit tiers: 2 keys → 800k / 64k context; 5 → 900k / 96k; 10 → 1m / 128k
Homepage scavenger mint cooldown: 10 minutes
Auto-update crash fix (NSAlert on main thread) and safer install staging

entries.title: Cloud chat sync
changes: Account rail and email/password auth via Supabase
Chats saved to private RLS-backed tables when signed in

entries.title: Usage upgrades
changes: Usage tab and Fathom Pro API key redemption for higher allowances
